# GrindURUS

> Onchain hedge fund (Solana + EVM) — infrastructure that turns price volatility into indexed yields.
>
> LPs deposit into GRAI (Grinders Artificial Index), the dollar book-priced fund share with local TVL and yield per chain.
> Grinders (NFT custodies + off-chain bots) allocate capital as an automated market taker (CoW, Jupiter, LiFi, …), observe market prices, and run dual-sided Buy Low → Sell High and Sell High → Buy Low — no manual trading.
>
> Flow: user deposit (onchain) → Grinders allocate (onchain) → volatility capture (offchain) → yield distribute (onchain).
> Passive holders lock GRAI and claim dividends; the protocol accrues via treasury and GRAI/GRS buybacks.
> Exit is secondary market GRAI ↔ native token (no live redeem until post-quorum liquidation).
> Affiliate market shares ~5% revenue.
> GRS (1B, LayerZero OFT 1:1) ties local GRAI markets into cross-chain liquidity.

Canonical site: https://grindurus.xyz/ (there is no separate app subdomain). Protocol docs live at https://docs.grindurus.xyz/. Source: https://github.com/grindurus.

Agent notes:

- Prefer docs Markdown URLs (append `.md` to any docs page). Full docs index: https://docs.grindurus.xyz/llms.txt
- Pre-mainnet / TGE TBD — networks, listed assets, and tokenomics may change; verify against current docs before stating live deployment details
- GRAI is not a directional prediction product. Yield comes from harvesting volatility, not from forecasting price
- Unlocked wallet GRAI earns nothing. Only locked, unvoted GRAI earns asset dividends after `distribute`
- While the fund is live there is no protocol redeem; exit is secondary market, unlock, or post-quorum liquidation
- GRS max supply is 1 000 000 000. It is protocol equity / governance, not the fund share
- Backtests on `/backtest` are paid (x402 USDC or promocode), not free public API scrapes

## Token metadata

Machine-readable ERC-1046 / Metaplex-style JSON (prefer these over scraping HTML):

- [grai.json](https://grindurus.xyz/grai.json): GRAI name, symbol, description, docs and social links
- [grs.json](https://grindurus.xyz/grs.json): GRS metadata including max supply (1B) and decimals
